Question: A 24-year-old woman, who is primiparous, suffers a miscarriage at 7 weeks of gestation. The anatomopathological study of the abortive remains indicates molar disease. We must inform you that:

Options:
opa. The risk of a new molar gestation in a future pregnancy is 50%.
opb. You should not get pregnant until you have regular check-ups and a year of negative beta-HCG levels.
opc. No further monitoring is necessary if the evacuation of the trophoblastic tissue was complete.
opd. It is necessary to carry out periodic check-ups since in 40% of cases it will develop a gestational trophoblastic neoplasm.

        ### Output Format
